title: sdr-daily-scratchpad-caleb-turner-2026-03-04
content:
Date: 2026-03-04
Owner: Caleb Turner
Quick wins goal: 30 outbound touches (calls+emails+LI) | 6 meaningful conversations | 2 qualified opps

TODAY PRIORITIES:
- 09:00 AM - Follow up with EastCo demo request (Mark R.) — confirm data retention & dedicated option
- 10:30 AM - Cold call blitz (accounts in fintech list) — focus on latency/cost pitch
- 01:00 PM - Send personalized sequence to Product Leads (Series B SaaS list)
- 03:00 PM - Prep for 3/06 demo with GlobalBank (internal demo notes below)
- Clear outstanding callbacks from last week (see CALL LIST)

CALL LIST / OUTREACH LOG:
1) EastCo (Mark Reilly, Head of ML Ops) — reached voicemail 2026-03-03
   CRM: SFDC 0055g00000ABCxyz | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/mark-reilly
   Notes: Interested in private deployment + SLAs. Concerned about KV cache and latency under 200ms.
   Next: Email follow-up with 1-pager + ask for 15m to confirm compliance needs (todo: attach Private brief).
   Status: warm (1 follow-up)

2) Finovate Labs (Priya Shah, Platform Eng Manager) — called, requested pricing ballpark
   Notes: Uses HuggingFace models internally, wants cost compare vs in-house. Mention Redwood Optimize batching and quantization recs.
   Next: Send pricing example + one-pager on Optimize. CC AE.
   Status: warm

3) RetailPulse (Jason Kim, CTO) — voicemail left
   Notes: Wants embeddings + reranking for search. Concerned about per-embedding cost.
   Next: Try again 3/05 morning; drop short case study in email.

4) GlobalBank (Aisha Mohammed, Dir. Data Science) — scheduled demo 3/06 10:00 PT
   Notes from discovery: regulated, needs VPC + KMS, audit logs, SOC2. Use-case: question-answering over compliance docs, latency SLO 300ms.
   Demo prep checklist (internal):
     - Show private deployment architecture slide
     - Walk through KMS integration + audit log example (ask SRE for logs export)
     - Bring Redwood Console demo: rollout/canary + tracing hooks
     - Prepare fallback policy example (hosted -> dedicated)
   Action: sync with Solutions Eng (Jamie) 3/05 to run through demo script.
   Status: qualified (demo scheduled)

5) Pipeline cleanup: several older leads with stale notes — need to update tags and next steps.

QUICK EMAIL TEMPLATES (short):
- Follow-up after voicemail:
  Hi {first_name},
  Left a quick voicemail — wanted to share a short 1-pager on how Redwood handles private deployments & latency SLOs. Happy to set a 15-min call this week to confirm fit.
  —Caleb

- Post-demo ask (to be customized):
  Great talking earlier — attaching the demo recording and the audit-log example. Next step: connect your infra lead + SRE to review KMS options.

TODAY TASKS / TODOs:
- [ ] Attach Private deployment one-pager to EastCo follow-up email (deadline: today EOD)
- [ ] Send Optimize pricing sample to Priya (Finovate) + cc AE (Maya)
- [ ] Block 30m with Jamie (solutions) for GlobalBank run-through (target 3/05)
- [ ] Update SFDC notes for RetailPulse and set follow-up task 3/05
- [ ] Move 4 stale leads to nurture (add tag: nurture-q2)

PIPELINE NOTES / OBSERVATIONS:
- Quick pattern: fintech leads prioritize latency & auditability; highlight private + KMS + console tracing.
- Early-stage SaaS prefer hosted API for speed of dev; highlight cost savings via Optimize.
- Need a short case study for embeddings cost-savings (ask marketing for 1-pager).

METRICS / DAILY KPIs (personal):
- Outbound touches target: 30 (calls/emails/LI)
- Meetings booked: 2+ per week target
- SQLs: 2+/week target

NOTES TO SELF:
- Keep scripts short on first call: 30s value prop + 1 specific example (latency/cost) + ask for 15m
- Remember to log every touch in SFDC immediately (reduce stale notes)

LINKS / QUICK REFERENCES:
- SDR playbook (Confluence): /display/GTM/SDR+Playbook
- Pricing examples folder: /shared_drives/go-to-market/pricing-examples/optimize

End of scratchpad.
